thread:
elaine: Hey team — LoamWorks kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to align POC scope, success criteria, and any enterprise blockers before the call. Quick asks: final success metrics, sample prompts/evals, security questionnaire status, pricing preference (hosted vs dedicated trial), infra requirements. cc @raj @tanya

raj: I can own model config and the eval harness. Need their dataset size, avg seq length, and whether streaming is required. Also: do they need function/tool calling in the agent flow?

tanya: I’ll handle pricing and contractual questions. Need to know if they require Dedicated capacity for predictable latency — Dedicated adds lead time for invoices/procurement.

elaine: From the pre-call notes: customer wants to validate two use cases — 1) internal doc summarization/search, 2) agent-assist for sales rep workflows. Stated success criteria: ~90% on key-phrase extraction for summaries and median latency <300ms for single-turn retrieval. Need to confirm these numbers with them.

raj: 90% is fine as a starting point but we should agree on eval methodology. Propose 200 labeled prompts per use case as held-out test. Also recommend prefix/KV caching for doc summarization to hit latency target. Config snippet I’ll send: ```model: llm-x-v1
quant: int8
batch: auto
prefix_cache: true
max_tokens: 1024```

sre-bot: reminder: Security questionnaire vendor-SecQ v3 is required for Private deployment. Must be returned within 48h of kickoff or Private onboarding will be delayed. Pinging #security-ops.

elaine: Can someone draft a short 30m kickoff agenda? I want intros, success criteria, data/access, infra + timelines, and next steps.

tanya: Draft agenda (30m): 1) Intros (5m) 2) Customer goals & OKRs (5m) 3) POC scope & success criteria (10m) 4) Data & access requirements (5m) 5) Infra choices + timeline (3m) 6) Eval cadence & handoffs (2m) 7) Next steps / owners (few mins). Thoughts?

raj: Blocker: if they want Private w/ KMS we’ll need their KMS provider, key rotation policy, and SOC docs. Also if streaming is required we need GPU sizing (I’ll coordinate with infra).

elaine: Action items: Raj — send model config + eval template by EOD. Tanya — pricing options (hosted trial, limited Dedicated pool, and rough TCO for 2-week POC). Elaine (me) — send agenda + calendar invite + pre-kickoff checklist and attach the sample prompt set.

tanya: :thumbsup: I’ll include optional commitment tiers and a temporary PO template for procurement to speed Dedicated onboarding if they choose that path.

elaine: Heads-up — LoamWorks stakeholders on the call: marco (CTO), rina (data lead), sam (security). I’ll ask them to confirm who will own data uploads and who will sign the sec questionnaire.

raj: Quick technical ask to add to pre-call checklist — can they provide 10 redaction examples (PII) and a small subset of docs (~500–1000 tokens each) so we can sanity-check redaction & tokenization ahead of the POC?

elaine: Good call. I’ll request that in the pre-call email. If there are no objections I’ll send the invite and agenda at 9am PT today and paste the eval template here. Closing — will share invite + agenda + eval template in this thread so everyone has a single source of truth.
